name: Craftsman 38188
blurb: Oregon prints one chain under 38188: 18″ bar, .325″ pitch, .050″ gauge, 72 drive links (H72).
intro: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide prints Craftsman 38188 on its own line with chain H72: 18″ bar, 72 drive links, .050″ gauge, .325″ pitch. This is not 3/8″ low-profile chain. The guide does not print a file size.

bars.note: Oregon prints H72 directly under Craftsman 38188: 18″ bar, 72 drive links, .050″ gauge, .325″ pitch. No file size is printed.

sources.title: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide: model line printed with saw-chain code, bar length, drive links, gauge and pitch
